$comment: DECLARED half of the storefront page inventory — what the router cannot say. Keys are vc-frontend route NAMES; a key the router no longer has fails `npm run pages:check`. A route absent here is `extended` with derived defaults. tier: core = always in scope for a global style/token/theme/ui-kit change; extended = in scope when the change touches its area, or by a WAIVED-with-reason decision otherwise. auth: the session(s) to visit it in — anonymous, signed-in (a personal account) or corporate (an organization member; the default for a route that requiresOrganization). fixtures: how a route param is acquired (never a literal — @td() alias or live-discover). visits: concrete visits when one route renders several pages (the catch-all) or a query variant matters; {name} placeholders are fixtures too; a visit with `setup` cannot be reached by a direct goto (a guard redirects), so pages:targets leaves it out of PIXEL and lists it for a browser lane or a WAIVE. Seeded from VCST-6232's widened Page set P (2026-11-02). Generator: scripts/maintenance/sync-storefront-pages.mjs.

fixtures.builderPagePath: live-discover: a published Builder.io page path of the store (e.g. the predefined-products page)

Matcher.note: The catch-all renders home, SEO-routed category/product pages and Builder pages.

fixtures.searchTerm: live-discover: a term that returns catalog products
fixtures.noResultTerm: random-data: an AGENT-TEST- string that matches nothing

fixtures.productId: live-discover: an in-stock product with images and variations

CompareProducts.note: Add 2+ products to compare first, or it renders the empty state.

fixtures.cartLine: live-discover: add one in-stock product before the visit (an empty cart is the anonymous visit)
a cart line; enter from /cart (the route guard redirects a direct visit back to the cart)
a cart line; enter from /cart — never place the order
a cart line; enter from /cart — never submit payment

CheckoutCompleted.note: Needs a just-placed order; out of scope for a run that creates no order.

fixtures.orderId: @td() completed order of the signed-in user (test-data/aliases.json orders/*), or live-discover the newest order

Addresses.note: Guard: a corporate member is redirected to the dashboard — visit as a personal account, or company addresses instead.

fixtures.listId: live-discover: a list of the signed-in user with items

fixtures.orderId: live-discover: an unpaid order of the signed-in user

fixtures.sharingKey: live-discover: a shared list's sharing key

fixtures.productId: live-discover: a loyalty-catalog product (store must have the loyalty catalog on)

fixtures.userId: live-discover: a user an operator may impersonate
